title: Update docs/delete-policy.md — curriculum_tracks moved from deletedAt to state/stateChangedAt in W3.28/W3.29
rule: AG-8 (schema diffs update their paired doc in the same PR) / Tier-4 canonical-doc factual drift

evidence.quote: replaced ad-hoc `isActive`/`deletedAt`/`deactivatedAt` tombstone columns with a single unified `state` enum column

why: curriculum_tracks has no `deletedAt` column at all today — it was replaced by `state`/`stateChangedAt`. A reader implementing new delete-policy-adjacent code from this doc would query/write a column that doesn't exist. The same doc's coverage table also never mentions daily_plans/point_configs/profile_programs/study_day_configs/outbox/curriculum_scopes/prior_completion_imports, all of which track_dao.dart and profile_repository_impl.dart delete explicitly.
recommendation: Update the table row to 'state = deleted + stateChangedAt'; consider adding rows for the other tables track_dao.dart/profile_repository_impl.dart already delete explicitly so the doc is a complete map of delete behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Doc's column-name claim matches an actual column in the current schema (grep-checkable).
